pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Bayreuth Variation
pages.notes: Bayreuth 5.Bxc6: plan 1 had an f4-f5 route (the f3-knight blocks f2-f4); plan 2 promised a passed pawn from a queenside majority crippled by the doubled c-pawns. Overview and plans now explain the structure after 5...dxc6 and d4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Wormald Attack, Grünfeld Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 needed ...Bxf3 before Qxf3/gxf3 (parser); reworded. Plan 4 had ...Re8 pressing e4 through Black's own e5-pawn; now after ...exd4. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Anderssen, 5...d6
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed the knight d2-f1 without a piece; now O-O, c3, Re1 and Nbd2-f1-g3. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Morphy Defence
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted "the b1-knight via d2-f1-g3" without Re1; fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Wormald Attack, 5...b5 6.Bb3 Bc5 7.c3
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3 (the queen's knight goes, after d4); plan 4 had ...exd4 with no d4-pawn. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Wormald Attack, 5...b5 6.Bb3 Be7
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2 with the d2-pawn in place. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Spanish: Wormald Attack, 5...Be7
pages.notes: Plan 3 routed Nb1-d2 with the d2-pawn in place. Fixed. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense
pages.notes: Plan 2 routed Nbd2-f1-g3 with the d2-pawn and f1-rook in place; now after Re1, c3 and d4. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense
pages.notes: Plan 1 rerouted the f3-knight; plan 3 suggested a3, which does not restrain ...b5. Overview and plan 3 now give 7.Ng5 d5 8.exd5 Nd4 and the a4 lever. British spelling.

pages.name: Ruy Lopez: Morphy Defense, Arkhangelsk Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 rerouted the f3-knight via d2-f1-g3; plan 4 invented a Black queenside majority (the pawns are symmetrical). Plan 4 now gives the modern ...Bc5. British spelling.
